Elena —

Thanks for the note and resume. High level: we want to remain competitive but within the SDE2 band. Please propose a market-competitive base with modest variable and equity aligned to our standard SDE2 target. Specific asks from my side:

- Base: please target the 50–75th percentile of our SDE2 band for SF (include exact salary).
- Bonus: typical target is 10% for this level; confirm target and max payout.
- Equity: propose a grant that reflects mid-point of SDE2 band (please translate to RSUs with vesting schedule).
- Sign-on: consider a small sign-on if we need to bridge between current comp and our base.
- Budget: confirm this is within current headcount budget (we have a funded SDE2 slot for Q3).

Please share a concise packet I can route to Markus for quick sign-off (finance) and to Neha for offer letter language. If you need a recommended number, start with base $160,000, 10% bonus target, 3,000 RSUs (4 yr, 1 yr cliff) and a $10k sign-on contingent on notice period.

—Lauren

Hi team —

Attached is the formal compensation proposal for Samir based on the SDE2 band and market data. Summary below (clean packet attached: comp_offer_summary_2028Q3.xlsx and offer_sheet_SamirKhatri.pdf):

Proposal summary (recommended):
- Base salary: $162,000 per year (annualized) — positioned at ~65th percentile for SDE2 in SF.
- Bonus: 10% target (annual, discretionary performance bonus); typical payout range 0–20% based on company & individual performance.
- Equity: 3,200 RSUs (time-based), 4-year vesting schedule with 1-year cliff; approximate grant value at current strike ~0.35% of team allocation (per comp model).
- Sign-on: $12,000 one-time cash sign-on, payable in first payroll cycle, clawback if <6 months tenure (standard).
- Start date target: 2028-10-15 (flexible if notice longer).

Rationale: candidate is above entry SDE2 in systems design and will move the runtime work forward; market benchmarks (SF tech comps) support the proposed base and a slightly elevated equity grant to close counteroffers. The total cash + equity package is within the approved hiring band if Markus confirms budget.

Requested approvals / next steps:
1) Markus — please confirm headcount budget and sign-off on the proposed cash/equity mix.
2) Lauren — confirm you are comfortable with the sign-on and start date.
3) If approved, I will prepare the offer letter and DS envelope for signature and coordinate with Elena to deliver to candidate.

Attachments referenced: comp_offer_summary_2028Q3.xlsx (detailed comp calc), offer_sheet_SamirKhatri.pdf (offer language draft), Samir_Khatri_resume.pdf

Thanks —
